releaseNotes: Smart Review always includes Smart Recommended and supports multiple specialties, systems and topics with a custom question count for each selected topic.
Exam Goal Planner supports multiple separately named exams and dates, with an individual daily question target for each exam.

Settings are grouped in a clearer order. Question reading supports English (US), English (UK) and Arabic, prefers a male voice when the device provides one, and toggles between Read aloud and Stop reading on the same button. English (US) remains the default.
Pediatrics separates Dr. Abdulrahman Al-Joaki MCQs from Previous Years' Exam Questions; both collections are organised by medical systems and topics.
Question stems use natural word wrapping without changing original question text.
The focus timer uses a real countdown, with completion sound and browser notification where supported.
Question-bank records, IDs, answer keys and existing explanations are preserved.
